description.text: Objectives The PhD program in Civil Engineering provides students with both solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and research skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of civil engineering. Students are expected to engage in high level scientific research, and to assume leadership role in the civil engineering industries. Duration Duration of the program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. Research Areas 1. Innovative Structural System Design 2. Structural Health Monitoring and Safety Evaluation 3. Foundation Engineering Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 13 credits, among which 10 must be core courses, 2 must be elective courses, and 1 must be academic report.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen Campus)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Have attained a Master's diploma with good marks. 4. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 5. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
